title: 見つけて！私らしさと自分勝手の境界線

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm visiting Chukyo Racecourse with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Ahhh, the Princess Fighter show was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! Your cheers have reached my heart!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: I'll transform the land's energy into my power and shine brighter than anyone else! Princess Rising!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ugyaaahhh! Curse yooou!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Princess Fighter is just amazing, isn't she? She's spunky and cool and cute, not to mention graceful and true to herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I really thought I could become just like her…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But I'm just a self-centered person who hurts others.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: Hey, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen is starting! Look at the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: Really?! That first-rate Umamusume is running, too, right? Hehe, how exciting!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Fear not, for I am here—the first-rate Umamusume, King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's King! Has she come to claim the king's throne again this year?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Isn't she past her time already? How long is she gonna keep trying to stay relevant?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?! Can you believe what that person just said about King?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Unforgivable! I have to do something about this! I can't let someone get away with that kind of bad-mouthi—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ATTENTION!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Please don't misunderstand, everyone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The only person who can decide what I do is myself. My actions don't concern you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're free to have your opinions and to say whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Still, I'll grant you the right to watch me—watch as I remain true to myself and carve out my own path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, King Halo runs in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. As for the result…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: King Halo wins! With a jaw-dropping display of dominance, King Halo claims first place!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Did you see my graceful, magnificent running?!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …Drat.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That's the first-rate Umamusume we love! Are you aiming to conquer the Dual Sprints again this year?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You should quit while you're ahead and end your career on a high note. Why keep fighting to satisfy your ego? I feel bad for the younger racers.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You think I'm being selfish?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ha. Don't make me laugh. I simply walk my own path, as my own individual.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Is that being selfish, or is that being true to myself? Only I have the right to make that judgment.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: Being self-centered and being yourself are two separate things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not wanting to hurt others is an admirable trait. On the other hand, staying true to your path means you may hurt someone along the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For every victor, there is a loser. Justice for one is not justice for all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The question is—are those actions born from your ego, or your individuality?
choice_data_list: You're the only one who gets to decide that.
You're the only one who gets to decide that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Only I… can decide…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, outside the student dorms…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You were at today's Takamatsunomiya Kinen, right, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You… you actually noticed I was there?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, I saw you from the paddock. So, what did you think of my race?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, I thought it was stunning, of course. You flew down the track like the wind.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're certain I didn't appear like a villain while in the paddock and winner's circle?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no, I didn't think that at all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You can be honest. I'm aware that some see me that way. Still…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I don't feel ashamed, nor do I think my conduct was self-centered. Quite the contrary—I'm proud that I stayed true to myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And I don't intend on changing my approach, even when I race against you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm going to give you a thrashing with everything I have. That's how I show respect to those who think to oppose me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: When I choose a course of action, what matters is whether I myself can take pride in it. What others think is of no concern to me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Something I myself can be proud of, not others…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking… Thinking about the difference between being self-centered and being myself.
choice_data_list: Did you come to a conclusion?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's true that my behavior before was self-centered, and I'm ashamed of that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But that's precisely why I can't simply succumb to pressure. I won't be self-centered, but I must stay true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So… for next month's Fan Fest, I want to take part in this event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess shows me a plan for a stage event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Last Year's Tiara Tour in Retrospect!" A talk show presented by glamorous Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It seems the Umamusume I competed against last year will be there, as well as all their fans.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A true princess wouldn't back down from an opportunity like this just because she felt intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see sincere determination burning in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But somewhere deeper, I sense a subtle tremor—a trembling accompanied by an eagerness to grow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Right.
